entities.name: Joseph Nguyễn Năng
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Joseph Nguyễn Năng is a Vietnamese prelate of the Catholic Church who has been a bishop since 2009 and serves as Archbishop of Hồ Chí Minh City since 2019. He was elected president of the Catholic Bishops' Conference of Vietnam in October 2022.
